title: loctree.overlay.intent.v1
description: Frozen contract for the AICX intent overlay consumed by loctree (substrate-makieta v4, C0-01). Carries THREE identities per Doctrine 6: evidence_event_id (stable source event, parser derivation v1), intent_id (persistent cluster identity, minted once by A1, persisted in the aicx side-index, NEVER recomputed from content) and content_hash (revision of the current distillate + relations; changes on merge/append). Relations target intent_id and must carry evidence (evidence_ref + confidence + observed_at). store_revision is produced EXCLUSIVELY by the C6 canonical store and describes the source corpus; overlay_revision is produced by A1 and changes with store_revision, snapshot/anchor catalog, or attribution/dedup/model/threshold versions. An attribution-only change MUST NOT mutate store_revision. Low-confidence attribution candidates live in unresolved_attributions (payload-only, Doctrine 7) and never reach the force-fed card.

schema.description: Optional self-describing schema tag for dispatch by consumers (I1-01, M1-01).

repo_id.description: Repository identity, org/repo or bare slug. Never an absolute filesystem path.

snapshot_commit.description: Loctree snapshot commit the overlay was aligned against (7-40 hex).

anchor_catalog_revision.description: Revision of the loctree.anchors.v1 catalog (emitted by L0-01) used for attribution.

store_revision.description: C6 canonical-store revision: sr1:<sha256-hex>. Hash over scoped corpus membership + canonical source content + extraction schema + parser producer version. Attribution versions can never alter it.

overlay_revision.description: A1 overlay revision: ov1:<sha256-hex>. Hash over repo_id + store_revision + snapshot_commit + anchor_catalog_revision + overlay schema + attribution/dedup versions + model + threshold.

producer_version.description: Version of the overlay producer (A1) that emitted this document.

unresolved_attributions.description: Attribution candidates below the confidence threshold. Payload-only (Doctrine 7): they must never be rendered into a force-fed card.

intentId.description: Persistent intent-cluster identity. Minted once at cluster creation, persisted in the aicx side-index, NEVER recomputed from content (Doctrine 6). Relations target this id, never content_hash.

contentHash.description: Revision hash of the canonical serialization of the current distillate (thesis + relations + refs). Changes on merge/append; never used as a relation target.

evidenceEventId.description: Stable source-event identity, parser derivation v1 (frozen in aicx docs/PARSER_NORMATIVE_CONTRACT.md §5): ev1:<agent>:<session_id>:<locator>:<unit_kind>:<hex16(sha256(raw_unit_bytes))>. Tokens reject '/', '\' and control characters, so an absolute filesystem path can never be an identity. Locator is a zero-padded physical ordinal or an adapter logical locator (step:<stepId>:<kind>, msg:<index>, artifact:<name>).

opaqueRef.description: Opaque store reference: chunk:<id> or session:<id>[#<span>]. Zero absolute paths by construction (path separators are outside the allowed alphabet).

evidenceRef.description: Proof pointer for a relation or attribution: an opaque store ref or a stable evidence event id.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm).

confidence.description: Attribution/relation confidence in [0, 1]. The delivery threshold (A1-01 gate) is configuration, not schema; abstention below threshold goes to unresolved_attributions.

anchorId.description: Stable anchor identity from the loctree.anchors.v1 catalog (emitted by L0-01).

signatureHash.description: Symbol signature hash from the anchor catalog.

relativePath.description: Repo-relative normalized path. Never absolute, never escaping the repo root.

qualifiedSymbol.description: Fully qualified symbol in the target language's canonical notation.

target.description: What the intent is about. kind:repo carries no path (repo-wide decision); kind:path requires a normalized relative path; kind:symbol requires qualified_symbol + language.

relation.description: Evidence-backed relation between intent clusters. Targets intent_id (persistent), NEVER content_hash (revision). A relation without evidence_ref/confidence/observed_at is invalid: 'evidence-backed supersede' must have somewhere to record its proof.

attribution.description: Typed join between a decision and a code anchor. EVIDENCE file:line proves a mention; the RELATION is carried here and its precision is gated (A1-01 golden set).

match_kind.description: How the match was established (open vocabulary owned by the A1-01 resolver, e.g. qualified_symbol, path_prefix, lexical, semantic, operator).

unresolvedAttribution.description: Attribution candidate below the confidence threshold. Payload-only: never force-fed (Doctrine 7).

ref.description: Evidence reference pair: the stable source event (evidence_event_id, born in the aicx parser) plus the opaque store ref used for descent-to-proof. Zero absolute paths.

thesis.description: Declarative distillate, one fact, max 200 characters.

status.description: Lifecycle marker. Rendered as ✓ (current), ⊘ (superseded), ✗ (disputed/anti-recommendation) in atlas cards.

verification_status.description: Evidence marker, SEPARATE from lifecycle (spec v4): [V] verified, [U] unverified, [R] refuted. 'refuted' is incompatible with status 'current' (cross-validation below).
